verdict.rationale: Dagster documents integrations for major ELT/data tools (dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt) that represent connectors as assets, showing a maintained integrations catalog, but evidence covers only a handful of named connectors (no broad SaaS/database/file connector catalog comparable to e.g. Airbyte/Fivetran's hundreds of sources) and relies on wrapping third-party ELT tools rather than shipping its own wide native connector library. missing for 10: evidence of a large/broad first-party connector catalog spanning many SaaS APIs, databases, and file systems; independent community corroboration of connector breadth or maintenance quality.
